climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation whose wine is made only from Gamay. It covers a group of communes including Montbrison, Boën-sur-Lignon and Champdieu. The Loire Valley wine region follows the river Loire from the Atlantic coast to near Orléans.
